description: This file defines the 'ext_rest_twitter' class which extends 'ext_rest' to implement Twitter REST connector functionality within the SuiteCRM platform. The class includes configuration settings, module filtering logic, and stub methods for getItem and getList.

classes.name: ext_rest_twitter
classes.description: A PHP class extending ext_rest that provides a Twitter-specific REST connector within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Twitter REST connector with configuration flags and allowed modules.

methods.name: filterAllowedModules
methods.description: Filters a list of modules to include only those permitted for this connector.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve a single item from Twitter, currently returns null.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Stub method intended to retrieve a list of items from Twitter, currently returns null.
